Implementation Plan Implementation plan Planning ref: `2749519a491c62fc179f8fcc19abef0c67d291b7` on `orchestrator/project-3601` (matches integration branch metadata). Automation / wiring - Change type: two permanent helper scripts, two focused test modules, one `agents.md` doc insertion. - Scheduler / PR-push entry point: none; no workflow wiring changes in this phase. - Long-running supervisor: none. - DB gate pattern: none. - Pending-removal registry: none; these are permanent utilities, not single-use or long-running automation scripts. Scope-mode: Hold Scope Reuse-audit: extends `scripts/ai_memory_lib.py::make_record_id` / `sanitize_segment` and the existing sibling-import/manual-test pattern Scope-mode justification: The issue already names the exact helper, test, and doc files, so the safest plan is to change only those artifacts. Per §6 priorities (Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed), the only low-cost “complete over shortcut” work worth folding in is stronger contract coverage inside the requested tests (time-controlled salted-ID assertions and cwd-independent repo-root assertions), because that improves correctness without broadening scope or changing any existing identifier contract. 1. Files likely to change. - `[new]` `scripts/repo_root.py` - `[new]` `scripts/generate_resource_id.py` - `[new]` `tests/test_repo_root_helper.py` - `[new]` `tests/test_generate_resource_id.py` - `[edit]` `agents.md` — insert `## Utility helpers` immediately after `## Override conventions`, keep the rest untouched. 2. Functions or modules to implement. - `scripts/repo_root.py` - `repo_root() -> Path`: start from `Path(__file__).resolve().parent`, walk upward at most 10 levels, return the first directory containing both `CLAUDE.md` and `.git/`. - `repo_root_from(start: Path) -> Path`: same walk from `start.resolve()`, raising `RuntimeError` with a clear marker/cap message on failure. - CLI: print the resolved root on success; exit non-zero on `RuntimeError`. - `scripts/generate_resource_id.py` - Follow the existing sibling-import pattern used by other `scripts/*.py` files so direct execution works cleanly. - `generate_id(prefix: str, salt: str | None = None) -> str`: - if `salt is None`, delegate directly to `make_record_id(prefix)`; - otherwise return `__`. - CLI: `--prefix` required, `--salt` optional, print only the ID. - `tests/test_repo_root_helper.py` - Manual runner style consistent with existing repo tests. - Cover real-repo success, nested-directory success, and markerless-tree failure. - `tests/test_generate_resource_id.py` - Parse IDs into prefix/timestamp/suffix. - Assert Phase-5 regex compatibility. - Freeze time for salted assertions so same-salt behavior is deterministic and non-flaky. - Assert unsalted calls vary because they delegate to `make_record_id`. - `agents.md` - Add `## Utility helpers` immediately after `## Override conventions`. - Describe the two helpers by file/function name and refer to the live `make_record_id(prefix)` helper by name, not a stale line number. 3. Data structures affected. - Repo-root sentinel contract: a repo root is a directory containing both `CLAUDE.md` and `.git/`. - ID format contract remains `_<14-digit UTC timestamp>_<10 lowercase hex>`. - No schema, workflow, label, or memory-record structure changes. 4. API/interface changes. - New Python helpers: - `repo_root()` - `repo_root_from(start: Path)` - `generate_id(prefix, salt=None)` - New CLIs: - `python3 scripts/repo_root.py` - `python3 scripts/generate_resource_id.py --prefix

[--salt ]` - No changes to `make_record_id`, existing identifiers, or existing contracts. Conflicts noted. - `docs/plans/awesome-claude-code-learnings-plan.md` is internally inconsistent about file placement: its Phase 7 steps use `scripts/repo_root.py` / `scripts/generate_resource_id.py`, while a later appendix cites `scripts/utils/repo_root.py` / `scripts/ids/generate_resource_id.py`. Follow the issue scope: top-level `scripts/`. - The same plan’s sanitization example (`"Mem.with.dots" -> "memwithdots"`) conflicts with the live Phase-5 contract in `scripts/ai_memory_lib.py::sanitize_segment` and `tests/test_record_id_format_contract.py`, which preserve safe dots/case and trim only leading/trailing `.` / `_`. The new wrapper/tests should follow the live contract. - The plan’s old `scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:480` pointer is stale; current repo guidance is to reference `make_record_id(prefix)` by name. Failure modes. - Markerless start path -> `repo_root_from()` raises clear `RuntimeError`. - `salt=""` is still a provided salt, so branching must be `salt is None`, not truthiness. - Same prefix + same salt + same second can produce the same salted ID; salted mode is deterministic, not globally unique. 5. Risks and edge cases. - `agents.md` is a hot/shared file; keep the insertion minimal. - A failure test that uses raw `/tmp` can be environment-dependent; use an isolated temp tree instead. - Salted-ID tests will flake if they rely on wall-clock timing; control the module time source in-test. - Do not broaden this phase into migrating existing callers to the new helpers. 6. Testing considerations. - Run: - `python3 tests/test_repo_root_helper.py` - `python3 tests/test_generate_resource_id.py` - `test_repo_root_helper.py` should cover: - `repo_root()` resolves the real repo root, ideally even after temporarily changing cwd. - `repo_root_from(REPO_ROOT / "scripts")` resolves back to repo root. - Markerless temp tree raises `RuntimeError`. - `test_generate_resource_id.py` should cover: - regex compatibility with the Phase-5 ID contract; - same salt + controlled different timestamps => same prefix/suffix, different timestamp; - same prefix + no salt => different unsalted suffixes; - prefix sanitization using the live contract, not the stale doc example. - No broader suite is needed; this phase is stdlib-only and isolated. Assumptions / missing context. - Assumed `files_touched` already includes the five scoped paths named in the issue. - Assumed this phase adds helpers only and does not adopt them across existing scripts. - No further clarification was needed beyond the orchestrator auto-answer. 7. Pre-execution self-check result. - Ref matches integration metadata; no branch blocker. - No private inputs, external docs, scheduler work, supervisor work, or DB gating required. - Reuse audit is satisfied: ID generation extends existing helpers; repo-root walking is the only net-new utility because no current upward-walk helper exists. - Plan preserves the existing Stable-ID contract and stays within the requested scope.
